lines.text: Amos says woe to those at ease in Zion, and tells them to go to Calneh, Hamath and Gath.
They lie on ivory beds, eat lambs and calves, and play the harp like Saul.
They will go into exile as the first captives, and the LORD abhors Jacob's pride.
If ten men are left in one house, they too will die, and the great house will be smashed.
They rejoice in Lo-debar, and the LORD will raise up a nation to oppress them from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of Kidron.
